title: Bug 648872: [UX][Manufacturing] Many actions are enabled on an empty "Released Produciton Orders" page resulting in errors when clicked
summary: Actions on the Released Production Orders page are now disabled when the page opens with no records, preventing errors when users click them on an empty list.
key_points: Page-level Boolean RecordActionsEnabled is set in OnAfterGetCurrRecord based on whether records exist
Disables navigation and processing action groups plus the Print Label action when no records are present
Individual action conditions still apply for stricter control, while group-level enablement handles nested and extension-added actions consistently
Transition from populated to empty list after initial load is not addressed as a known platform limitation
Test coverage includes initial empty and non-empty page states plus subcontracting extension actions
quote: Disable record-dependent actions on Released Production Orders when the page opens without any released production orders.
